scenes.title: Level 1: Zero
scenes.subtitle: Meet your guitar
lines: Meet your guitar, learn its parts, and get every string in tune.
Play each open string — let's make music together.

scenes.heading: In this level
lines: After this level, you'll know your guitar's parts, hold it confidently, and tune it yourself.
You'll play each of the six strings clearly, one by one, so the app can hear them.
You'll be ready to move on to your next lesson, where you'll start playing your first chords.
Let's start with your guitar — take a close look at its parts and how to hold it.
